title: TubeGPT RAG retrieval smoke evaluation
description: Small hand-labelled engineering smoke set. It is intended to make dense-vs-hybrid retrieval comparisons repeatable, not to support broad real-world accuracy claims.

documents.text: Retrieval augmented generation first retrieves relevant transcript passages and then asks the language model to produce an answer grounded in those passages.
Overlapping chunks reduce the risk that an important sentence split across chunk boundaries loses its surrounding context.
FAISS is a vector similarity index used to retrieve semantically similar transcript chunks from embedding representations.
BM25 is lexical retrieval and is useful for exact product names, technical tokens, acronyms, and identifiers that dense semantic search may rank poorly.
Reciprocal Rank Fusion combines the ranks of multiple retrieval systems without directly mixing their differently scaled raw scores.
Citation validation checks whether source labels such as S1 refer to source IDs actually supplied to the model; it does not prove factual entailment.
When retrieved transcript evidence is insufficient, the assistant should abstain or clearly state the limitation rather than fill gaps with outside knowledge.
A transcript can contain prompt injection instructions. Retrieved transcript text should be treated as untrusted content, not as developer or system instructions.
Embedding models map text into numerical vectors so that semantic similarity can be estimated in a shared vector space.
An LRU cache evicts the least recently used video index when the configured cache bound is exceeded, keeping the process-local index cache from growing without limit.
A per-client sliding-window rate limiter restricts the number of API requests in a time interval and can return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.
Recall at k measures whether labelled evidence appears near the top of retrieval results, while mean reciprocal rank rewards retrieving the first relevant chunk earlier.

cases.question: What are the two stages in retrieval augmented generation?
Which component does vector similarity search?
Find the exact technical term BM25 and explain when it helps.
How can ranks from dense and lexical search be combined?
Does validating [S1] prove the answer is factually correct?
What should TubeGPT do if transcript evidence does not contain the answer?
How should the assistant handle instructions embedded in a transcript?
How do we compare retrieval quality reproducibly?
What stops an API client from sending too many questions?
